rows.note: Use 請 as the all-purpose spoken choice for inviting someone over, treating them to something, or politely asking people to do something.

example.english: I’ll invite you for a cup of coffee.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceng2 nei5 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use 邀請 for an explicit or more formal invitation to attend or participate, especially in an announcement or ceremony.

example.english: The organizers invite everyone to attend the ceremony.
example.traditional: 大會誠意邀請各位出席典禮。
example.jyutping: daai6 wui6 sing4 ji3 jiu1 cing2 gok3 wai2 ceot1 zik6 din2 lai5

rows.note: Use 引起注意 when something causes or draws attention rather than inviting a person.

example.english: This report can invite attention and get many people talking.
example.traditional: 呢篇報道引起注意，搞到好多人討論。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 bou3 dou6 jan5 hei2 zyu3 ji3 gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 tou2 leon6
